statements.status_notes: CVE-2026-107778 is a NULL pointer dereference in make_cred_list() in krb5_rd_cred() (src/lib/krb5/krb/rd_cred.c): a KRB-CRED message with more tickets than encrypted ticket-info entries crashes the receiving service, for example a GSS-API acceptor handling forwarded credentials from an authenticated client. MIT fixed it in krb5 1.22.3 (https://mailman.mit.edu/pipermail/kerberos-announce/2026q4/000212.html) with commit https://github.com/krb5/krb5/commit/62196e2b269159a5465f5b8d0ed7cf6f29c3282a on the 1.22 branch (ticket 9211, version_fixed 1.22.3), the fix the Debian tracker records for this CVE (https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/CVE-2026-107778). DHI krb5 for Alpine 3.23 builds MIT krb5 from the Alpine aports recipe and has two published builds, 1.22.1-r0 and 1.22.3-r0. Alpine's 1.22.3-r0 recipe lists this CVE among its security fixes (https://gitlab.alpinelinux.org/alpine/aports/-/blob/3.23-stable/main/krb5/APKBUILD), and the libkrb5 library in the published 1.22.3-r0 krb5-libs package for x86_64 and aarch64 reports krb5-1.22.3-final. 1.22.1-r0 is MIT 1.22.1, which predates the fix. The range ends at 1.22.3-r0, the first published build with the fix.
